Synopsis:
    A 24-hour nationwide strike in the Netherlands halted all public transport on Sept 9, organised by labour unions opposing government plans to cut up to €6.5bn in annual welfare spending (primarily unemployment benefits) to fund defence increases. The centre-right minority government, lacking a parliamentary majority, faces growing political pressure. The left-wing Pro party has aligned with unions, demanding full withdrawal of welfare cuts. Near-term focus is on budget negotiations following the official budget presentation on September 15.
